claims.statement: Tom Allen was an Englishman born at Birmingham, England, on April 23, 1839 (the article prints 1889).
Tom Allen was described as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: retired champion pugilist of the world, died at

claims.statement: Tom Allen figured in 14 prize ring matches in England and ten in America.
claims.excerpt: figured in 14 prize ring matches in England and ten in

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Jim Stewart in England on March 10, 1879, in a match for 50 pounds a side.
claims.excerpt: being with Jim Stewart on March 10, 1879

claims.statement: Tom Allen opened a saloon near the present home of the Boatmen's Bank, at Fourth Street and Washington Avenue, in 1868.
claims.excerpt: Fourth street and Washington avenue, in 1868
places: Fourth Street and Washington Avenue, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen had been a tenant of the same real estate firm ever since 1868, in different parts of the city.
claims.excerpt: ever since had been a tenant of the same real estate firm, in different parts of the city

claims.statement: Tom Allen had been very low for several days before he died.
claims.excerpt: Allen had been very low for several days

claims.statement: Tom Allen died at the Baptist Hospital, Garrison and Franklin avenues, St. Louis, at 7:35 a.m. on Sunday, April 5, 1903.
claims.excerpt: the Baptist Hospital, Garrison and Franklin avenues, at 7:35 o'clock
places: Baptist Hospital, Garrison and Franklin avenues, St. Louis

fights.excerpt: It lasted 55 minutes, was 16 rounds in duration and was won by Allen
fights.notes: From Allen's own official record, as printed in 1903. Other bouts are only counted (14 in England, 10 in America).

notes: Birth year printed 1889; 1839 is inferred from the text's own age context and other notes, so low confidence. Death day worked out from 'Sunday' (article dated Friday 10 April 1903); 262 gives 6 April.
